notes.text: EtherChannel Lab 8 - 10-Link Bundle: 10 LACP links SW1-SW2 (F0/1-10). Real IOS allows max 8 active + 8 hot-standby (H); this simulator bundles all 10. SW1 lacp system-priority 100, F0/9-10 port-priority 100 (on real gear these win). Test: shut F0/1-9 on SW1, PC1 192.168.1.1 still pings PC2 192.168.1.2 over 1 link.
